title: Africa C.D.C. Chief Faces Turmoil Over Management Amid Ebola Crisis
summary_full: Scrutiny has fallen on Dr. Jean Kaseya, the director general of the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, after reports of staff intimidation and mismanagement of funds.
